title: Hum musafir hai majboor hai
body:
Hum musafir hai majboor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Haay..
<<MINI>>
Hum musafir hai majboor hai..(4)
Zulm dhao na ae zalimo, Hum musafir hai majboor hai..(2)
Dil jalao na ae zalimo, hum musafir hai majboor hai
Zulm dhao na ae zalimo, Hum musafir hai majboor hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Mera nana rasoole khuda, mera baba ali murtaza
Kalma go ho to sunlo zara, chhod do tum mera raasta
<<MINI>>
yu satao na ae zalimo, hum musafir hai majboor hai
Zulm dhao na ae zalimo, Hum musafir hai majboor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Hai chala ghar se ibn-e-ali, karke nana se waada yahi
chahe qeemat ho kitni badi, mai bachaunga deene nabi
<<MINI>>
ye bhulao na ae zalimo,  hum musafir hai majboor hai
Zulm dhao na ae zalimo, Hum musafir hai majboor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Labpe tasbeeh hai shukre khuda, zere khanjar sare karbala
aisa sajda karunga adaa, naaz jispar kare ambiya
<<MINI>>
aazmao na ae zalimo,  hum musafir hai majboor hai
Zulm dhao na ae zalimo, Hum musafir hai majboor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Apne hatho pe asghar liye, shahe mazloom the keh rahe
qatl karna hai kardo mujhe, ghoot pani pila do ise
<<MINI>>
yu rulao na ae zalimo, hum musafir hai majboor hai
Zulm dhao na ae zalimo, Hum musafir hai majboor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Hum hi hai hujjate kibriya, hum hi hai warise ambiya
gher kar yu sare karbala, aale ahmed ko yu bekhata
<<MINI>>
khu bahao na ae zalimo, hum musafir hai majboor hai
Zulm dhao na ae zalimo, Hum musafir hai majboor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Tha yahi nauha ek shame ghum, kalma goyo na dhao sitam
karke sar wariso ke qalam, baandh kar rassiyo me haram
<<MINI>>
muskurao na ae zalimo, hum musafir hai majboor hai
Zulm dhao na ae zalimo, Hum musafir hai majboor hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Sach hai jawwad-o-meesum yahi, dee ki mohsin hai aale nabi
sar husaini rida zainabi, de rahi hai sada aaj bhi
<<MINI>>
dil dukhao na ae zalimo, hum musafir hai majboor hai
Zulm dhao na ae zalimo, Hum musafir hai majboor hai
Hum musafir hai majboor hai..(3)
